highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.1 avoids unsafe Vulkan descriptor-pool destruction after allocation failures on Imagination drivers.
highlights_body: This unreleased servicing update stays on Skia m157 without changing managed bindings or the native ABI.

bullets.detail: Ganesh and Graphite deliberately abandon affected descriptor pools after host or device out-of-memory errors rather than destroying them in an unsafe driver state. Graphite also rejects subsequent allocations through a null pool handle. The workaround trades pool cleanup for safety.
